changelog: Vehicle respawn fix: abandoned vehicles no longer spawn over and over on the same spot.

Opulus Give Menu NUI: full visual interface accessible via /opulus_give (with no args) or dedicated button in /conf_acn_opulus VR Items tab, featuring target player selector, visual item search grid, category filters, quantity steppers, and firearm reserve ammo controls.

Opulus Item Creator NUI: complete item builder interface accessible via /opulus_item, /opulus_item_create, or in /conf_acn_opulus to create, configure, and register custom VR items live in catalog with instant KVP persistence and hot-sync across all clients.
Live Card Preview: dynamic real-time item preview updating instantly with thumbnail, slug, category badge, weapon models, ammo links, health/hunger/thirst/fuel values, and description.
Type-specific dynamic attributes: contextual form fields for weapons (GTA models and associated ammunition), medical items, food, drinks, vehicle fuel, and stackable materials.
Instant in-game test integration: added 1-click test button right after creating an item to test it immediately in your VR backpack.
Opulus vehicle commands: /opulus_car [model] and /opulus_veh to instantly spawn vehicles in your instance routing bucket with keys, full fuel, unlocked doors, and auto-driver warp.
Automatic routing bucket sync & vehicle claim: approaching or entering any vehicle automatically shifts it to your virtual instance bucket, unlocks doors, grants keys, and provides fuel.
In-game vehicle test button: added quick 1-click test spawn button in /conf_acn_opulus Map tab under Vehicles and on each vehicle card.
Spawned vehicle usability fix: resolved issue where spawned vehicles were unusable due to routing bucket mismatch or uninitialized fuel.
Gunshot noise detection & horde rush: unsuppressed gunfire alerts zombies within 130m and triggers aggressive reinforcement hordes.
Zombie horde spawn points: in-game /conf_acn_opulus horde points with % chance, min/max horde size, and cooldowns.
Periodic roaming hordes: dynamic wandering horde waves hunt players for increased survival difficulty.
Stealth advantage: melee weapons and silencer attachments remain silent without alerting hordes.
Hardcore zombie difficulty: broader sight and hearing range, higher damage, faster attack speeds, and increased population cap.
Admin VR give command: /opulus_give to give any VR item, weapon, or ammo with auto-mag loading, reserve ammo, and offline profile persistence.
In-game VR item creator: /opulus_item create/delete/list to register and manage custom items directly from chat or console.
1-Click VR test buttons: instant Give to me (VR) button in editor and quick-give buttons on every item card in /conf_acn_opulus.
Crash & restart protection: dual-layer persistent origin tracking (server + client KVP) and auto-restore to original location and bucket 0 on crash, restart, or disconnect.
Anti-ped duplication: automatic server and client purge of all clone entities on resource stop and restart.
Vehicle access fix: dirtbikes, motorcycles, and vehicles are now unlocked and accessible upon spawn with key bypass.
Hunger and thirst isolation: RP needs are safely saved upon entering Opulus and perfectly restored upon returning to the normal server.
Cross-framework status synchronization: Opulus survival status is synchronized in real time with the framework HUD, and default VR experiences provide 100% full needs.
